methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 electric countertop oil-immersion deep fryers (distinct from air fryers) spanning entry-level compact models through large dual-basket units from Presto, T-fal, Hamilton Beach, Cuisinart, Breville, Secura, Chefman, and Elite Gourmet. Specs were independently re-verified against official manufacturer product pages (gopresto.com, t-fal.com, hamiltonbeach.com, cuisinart.com, breville.com, chefman.com, shopelitegourmet.com) and corroborated via major retailer listings (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Lowe's, Best Buy) plus user-manual repositories. Booleans (adjustable_thermostat, viewing_window) are true when the feature is explicitly documented and null when neither presence nor absence is confirmed on the manufacturer page; oil_capacity_l is the manufacturer-stated oil fill volume in liters; food_capacity_lb is the stated per-batch food load in pounds; wattage_w and max_temp_f are nameplate values; basket_count is the number of fry baskets included; priceUsd reflects the US MSRP or typical published retail price verified at time of access. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Adversarial pass: all 11 products verified to exist; prices confirmed on manufacturer pages; Breville max_temp filled from manual; Elite Gourmet wattage held at manufacturer-stated 1500W (third-party 2000W listings rejected); two source URLs corrected to canonical manufacturer pages.

products.name: Presto FryDaddy Electric Deep Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on gopresto.com: 120V/1200W, 4-cup (0.95L) oil capacity, automatic fixed thermostat (maintains ~375F, no adjustable control), no basket (uses a scoop). Price $46.99 confirmed on gopresto.com. Food capacity in lbs not published; basket_count=0 (ships with scoop).

products.name: Presto CoolDaddy Cool-Touch Deep Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on gopresto.com: 1500W, 2-quart (1.9L) oil capacity, adjustable thermostat (range 250-375F), viewing window in cover. Price $75.99 confirmed on gopresto.com. max_temp_f=375 = top of documented 250-375F range; food capacity in lbs not stated.

products.name: T-fal Ultimate EZ Clean Deep Fryer FR8000
products.provenance: Re-verified on t-fal.com: 3.5L oil capacity, 2.65 lb food capacity, adjustable temperature 300-375F (max_temp_f=375), oil filtration system, large viewing window. MSRP $139.99 on t-fal.com. 1700W confirmed via Walmart/Amazon listings and product title.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Cool-Touch Electric Deep Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on hamiltonbeach.com: 2L (8-cup) oil capacity, adjustable temperature control with ready light, viewing window in lid, single basket with hooks. Price $69.99 on hamiltonbeach.com. 1500W confirmed via Amazon listing. Max temp and food capacity in lbs not published on manufacturer page; max_temp_f=null rather than guessing.

products.name: Cuisinart 4-Quart Deep Fryer CDF-200P1
products.provenance: Re-verified on cuisinart.com and retailer listings: 1800W immersion-style element, 1-gallon (3.8L) removable stainless oil container, 2.3 lb food capacity, adjustable temperature up to 375F, viewing window in lid, single stainless basket. MSRP $99.95.

products.name: Breville Smart Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on breville.com: 1800W, 4-quart (3.8L) oil capacity, $199.95 MSRP, electronic thermostat with color LCD, 7 cooking presets. max_temp_f corrected null->375 (documented 250-375F range per BDF500XL instruction manual and multiple retailers). Food capacity 2.5 lb per Amazon/retailer listings. Source URL updated to canonical Breville US product page. viewing_window left null: closed digital lid, not documented either way on official page.

products.name: Secura 1700-Watt Triple Basket Electric Deep Fryer
products.priceNote: Typical retail price per Amazon/eBay listings; no official MSRP page
products.provenance: Re-verified on thesecura.com and Amazon (B007OZXVDM): 1700W immersion element, 4.0L (17-cup) removable oil tank, triple-basket system (one jumbo + two side-by-side), adjustable heat control 250-375F (max_temp_f=375), see-through window and odor filter in lid, 60-min timer. Price ~$79.99 consistent across listings; Secura does not publish a separate MSRP. Food capacity in lbs not published.

products.name: Chefman Jumbo Fry 4.5-Quart Deep Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on chefman.com Jumbo Fry product page: 1700W/120V, 4.5-quart (4.25L) capacity, 375F max temp, adjustable temperature with LED indicators, removable lid with viewing window, single drain basket. Price $69.99 (sale; reg $79.99) on chefman.com. Food capacity 2.0 lb confirmed from page text ('up to two pounds of food at once'). Source URL corrected from jumbo-size-deep-fryer to canonical jumbo-deep-fryer product page.

products.name: Presto Dual Basket ProFry Immersion Element Deep Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on gopresto.com: 120V/1800W immersion element, 5-quart (4.7L) oil capacity, dual oblong baskets, adjustable thermostat with signal light, $99.99 MSRP. 12-cup food capacity stated (not converted to lbs by manufacturer). Max temp not stated on product page (max_temp_f=null); no viewing window listed (viewing_window=false).

products.name: Elite Gourmet Electric Immersion Deep Fryer EDF-3500
products.provenance: Re-verified on shopelitegourmet.com: 1500W, 3.5-quart (3.3L) oil capacity (14-cup total), 2.3 lb food capacity, heats to 375F, adjustable temperature knob with 30-min timer, viewing window with charcoal air filter, $39.99. Wattage held at manufacturer-store-stated 1500W; rejected third-party (Walmart/Best Buy) 2000W listings as inconsistent with the official page.

products.name: Hamilton Beach 8-Cup Deep Fryer
products.provenance: Re-verified on hamiltonbeach.com: 1500W immersed element, 8-cup (1.9L) oil capacity, single chrome-plated basket, adjustable thermostat, $62.99 (model 35335G). max_temp_f=375 per use-and-care guide. Viewing window not listed on manufacturer page (viewing_window=false). Food capacity in lbs not published (cooks up to 6 cups of food).
